name: How do I choose the right location for a new bathroom addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right location for a new bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the ideal location for a bathroom addition involves considering several practical and aesthetic factors. Proximity to existing plumbing lines can help reduce costs, but isn't always a limiting factor. Think about accessibility, natural light, and how the new bathroom will integrate with your home's overall layout. Common locations include converting existing unused space, adding onto an exterior wall, or utilizing a large bedroom as a master suite with an attached bathroom. We can help assess your home's structure and existing utilities to recommend the best placement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a bathroom addition location by considering existing plumbing, accessibility, natural light, and overall home flow. We can help assess structural feasibility.
